benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: WordStream's 2026 data puts Meta leads in home and home improvement at $42.95 with a 5.32% conversion rate. Your $112 cost per lead sits well above that range.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Furnace demand peaks now through January
seasonal.body: Heating searches spike in the first cold weeks. Homeowners delay replacement until failure, then book fast. Emergency search clicks run $20–$55 in this window.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: Rivals shifting to Local Services Ads
competitor.body: HVAC contractors are moving budget to Google Local Services Ads at roughly $51 per lead with a 44% booking rate. You are not currently visible in that channel.

recommendations.title: Test Google Local Services Ads for heating calls
recommendations.detail: Benchmarks show $51 per lead and 44% booking rate for HVAC. Your 5-star rating and 344 reviews qualify you for strong placement immediately.

recommendations.title: Rework the Instagram furnace form or pause it
recommendations.detail: At $112 per lead you are paying nearly triple benchmark. Consider tighter Crestwood geo-targeting, a video creative test, or shifting budget to search.

recommendations.title: Push every job to request a Google review
recommendations.detail: Reviews drive the Business Profile traffic that generated 99 calls and 260 direction requests this period. Worth protecting and growing during peak season.
